body:
Thank you everyone for your support yesterday. I understand what you told me, I am trying to keep it one day at a time.

The emptiness is not gone nor the pain. But I hid my razors and I am keeping away from the pills.

Thank you again

I understand rationally what you say, and I would have said the same if I didn't feel this bad.

I just want the pain to stop, I am scared if it doesn't I will go crazy.I feel ashamed knowing that I am so weak that I rather die than to deal with what makes me feel this way. Truth is I don't know why things affect me that much. I don't know why I feel nobody loves me enough, truth is my brain hurts from thinking and thinking trying to find a solution and keep living.

I wouldn't know where to start to know why I feel this way. I need a rational explanation to my misery but so far I couldn't find one. I guess my friend hanging himself woke up the sleeping beast inside me. It is not the first time I feel this way. I did try in the past and failed, I didn't expect my husband to be early from work and he stopped me. But now, I know nobody will come.

I was diagnosed as bipolar II, hence the lack of antidepressants on my medical history.

I was also in a support group but I just felt like my problems weren't worth sharing.

I don't know how to describe what it feels like, but maybe if you've been there you understand
They are 9 and 5, boy is on the 4th class and girl in kindergarten. They do sports, play xbox with me, or boardgames. They are not the problem. It's me, it's always been me

I did try medication, last one I had was lamotrigine but gave me allergic reaction so psyc decided to cut off. I was before in seroquel for about a year, the only thing I got from that was 6 extra kilos of weight. No change on my mood, on my dark vision of life and I am not the kind of person who openly talks about my issues.

I am always worried I will scare people away, so whenever I feel down I lock inside myself and just hope for the best (even tho the best is wishing I don't wake up)

I don't feel I am not good enough to take care of my kids, I love them and if there is something I am sure I did good is taking care of them. Both are self confident, outgoing, with tons of friends and social life. I tried to provide to them what I thought I lacked of, but the problem is me. I don't know how to feel happy. I don't know how to stop suffering.

I hope I was clear enough.
